jose/3d-space.title: Chronocity 3D artwork explorer
jose/3d-space.summary: Explore your album covers in a cinematic industrial world.
highlights: Fly between original album artworks in three dimensions.
Approach a playlist to unfold its albums into an artwork gallery.
Try cinematic camera tours and optional holographic artwork.
jose/3d-space.tryIt: Open Albums or Playlists and choose Chronocity. Select Cinematic for a camera tour; move or press Escape to take control.
